title: why doctor summary (serve)
description: Payload of `why serve`'s GET /api/doctor: the bundle health report summarized for header chips and a plain list view. Items are pre-rendered display strings — the same lines the `why doctor` CLI prints — so a renderer carries no health semantics. docs/ui-contract.md annotates this schema.

healthy.description: No red findings — mirrors the CLI's exit-0 condition.

head.description: Short sha the as_of checks ran against; null when there is no enclosing repo.

sections.description: All seven doctor sections, in the CLI's render order.

items.description: One pre-rendered display line per finding.

skipped.description: Present only when the check could not run (e.g. as_of freshness outside a git repo) — say so, never silently zero.
